design.decision: Draw trumps from the first lead to protect side-suit winners, or start a run in trump.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first unbroken [♠] lead, which is a legal-play change. After that, opponents can't hide behind unbroken trumps.
design.rationale: Lead control is the thinnest enabler family. This is the simplest possible play-freedom change, valuable for any strong hand before a build exists.
design.draftText: Your team can lead [♠] before [♠]s are broken
design.hooks: Rule-bender flag per team: the kernel's lead-legality check treats [♠]s as broken for the owning team's leads. It changes nothing else and has no conflict with other rule benders.

history.note: draft-common: merged into ca-lead-spades, an identical design from another cluster.
